block.guhs.park_verrekijker.lore: Right-click: look far away, just like through a real spyglass. Sneak = look normally again
block.guhs.park_wensstam.lore: Hang a renamed piece of paper on the trunk: your wish goes up in the tree
item.guhs.park_kruimels.lore: Right-click: strew a handful. The Pigeonguhs come running right away!
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.hallo0: Hello, dear! Have you come to feed the Pigeonguhs too? They're such good company. Coo!
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.hallo1: I used to feed the pigeons with Grandpa Cheeseguh. He ate half the crumbs himself, nyeg.
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.hallo2: That chubby one is called Crumbs. And that one too. Actually, they're all called Crumbs.
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.hallo3: No running, now. Pigeons like it calm. And crumbs. Mostly crumbs.
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.kruimels: Here, a handful of breadcrumbs for you. Go on and strew them (right-click), they'll come straight over!
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.genoeg: You've still got crumbs, dear. Strew those first!
quest.guhs.parkb.oma.morgen: You'll get another handful tomorrow. Granny has to be a little careful too, nyeg.
gui.guhs.parkb.kruimels.gestrooid: You strew a handful of crumbs. Coo!
gui.guhs.parkb.duif.gevoerd: Coo! The Pigeonguh gobbles up your crumbs.
gui.guhs.parkb.verrekijker.kijk: You look through the telescope. Sneak (shift) to stop.
gui.guhs.parkb.verrekijker.toren: From the highest spot in the park you can see everything. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.applaus: The guh kids clap their little paws. Nyeg nyeg!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.1: Welcome to the puppet theatre! Today: Guh and the Stolen Nibble. Shhh, it's starting!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.2: Hello, kids! Look what I've got: a really, really big cheese nibble. Mmm, nyeg!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.3: I'll just put it down here, on the edge. I'm off to get a napkin.
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.4: Hee hee hee... A nibble, just lying on the edge? That's MINE now!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.6: Behind me? Huh? I don't see anything at all...
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.8: AHA! Mika! My nibble! Give it back, you little muncher!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.9: Okay, okay... But can I have just one tiny bite? I was so hungry.
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.10: Of course! Sharing is sweet. Nibbling together tastes twice as good. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.parkb.poppenkast.11: The end! Give a clap with your paws. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.parkb.kind.0: I want to see the puppet show! Will you click on the stage?
quest.guhs.parkb.kind.1: Shhh! It's about to start. I hope Mika comes again. Mika is so funny!
quest.guhs.parkb.kind.2: I've seen the show ten times already. I'm going to see it ten more times. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.parkb.kind.3: If you see Mika, you have to shout really loud. That's the rule.
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.gehangen: Your wish is hanging in the tree: "%s". It's bound to come true, nyeg!
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.vervangen: Your oldest wish makes way for your new one (you may hang %s per tree).
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.geen_naam: Write your wish on the paper first: rename it on an anvil.
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.vol: There's no free spot left on the branches. Try again in a little while.
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.info: %s wishes hang in this tree. Hang one yourself: right-click the trunk with a renamed piece of paper.
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.weg: You took your wishes down from the tree again.
gui.guhs.parkb.wens.gewist: Took %s wishes down from the tree.
quest.guhs.parkb.mika.mok0: Hmph. I'm just sitting here. Is that not allowed or something?
quest.guhs.parkb.mika.mok1: That sign is mean. I'm only a VERY little bit Mika.
quest.guhs.parkb.mika.mok2: Everybody's allowed on a bench. Except Mikas. That's just not fair...
quest.guhs.parkb.mika.mok3: Go away. Or... do you happen to have a cheese nibble? No? Hmph.
quest.guhs.parkb.mika.duw: Hey! This is MY bench! Hmph!
quest.guhs.parkb.mika.blij: A... a cheese nibble? For ME? Nyeg! Thank you! You know what? I'll go find a bench where Mikas ARE allowed to sit. Bye!
gui.guhs.parkb.mika.weg: The Mika hops away happily. He'll probably be back tomorrow.
gui.guhs.parkb.mika.terug: %s Mikas are back on their benches.
gui.guhs.parkb.cmd.toren: Lookout towers in this park: %s (at height %s, the highest plekje spot %s)
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.duifguhtje: Rarity: common (only in Nibble Park, near Granny Guh)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.duifguhtje: A chubby grey bird with a shiny green-and-purple neck and real guh eyes. Pigeonguhs live with Granny Guh in Nibble Park and love breadcrumbs: hold a few and they flutter around you. Coo!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkb_duiven.title: Feeding the pigeons with Granny
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkb_duiven.desc: In some Nibble Parks, &dGranny Guh&r sits on her bench feeding the &dPigeonguhs&r. Ask her for a handful of &6breadcrumbs&r and strew some yourself (right-click). Coo!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkb_duifguhtje.de: Take a close look at a &dPigeonguh&r: its page in the Guhdex fills in (a bonus page: it doesn't count towards 'everything collected').
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkb_toren.title: The highest spot
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkb_toren.desc: A &6lookout tower&r always stands on the highest spot of its park. Climb to the top and look through the &6telescope&r.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkb_poppenkast.de: Click the stage of a &6puppet theatre&r and watch the show. Shout along with the guh kids!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkb_wens.title: Make a wish
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkb_wens.desc: Rename a piece of &6paper&r on an anvil (that's your wish) and hang it on the trunk of a &6wishing tree&r. Everybody can read your wish after that. Keep it sweet, okay!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkb_mika.title: A happy Mika
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.parkb_mika.desc: On a bench with the sign 'No Mikas allowed' there's always a &csulky Mika&r. He does shove if you get too close, but a &6cheese nibble&r makes him very happy...
